messages:
Hiro: Hi everyone, day 1 here. Quick accessibility question for security onboarding: I have sensory processing needs and the phishing simulation emails can be stressful. Is there an accommodation pathway or a way to opt into a learning-only version? Also curious if I can delay MDM enrollment until after a short setup period?

Lina: Welcome Hiro 44b We do have accommodations. Please DM People Ops or reply here and we can make a note on your onboarding record. For phish sims we can switch you to an educational track (no negative notifications, just practice emails) for the first 30 days. No need to give details publicly.

Avery: Re MDM: short-term delay is possible for documented accommodations. Normally devices should be enrolled within 72 hours; with an accommodation we can extend that to 2 weeks, but we may provide a loaner laptop with required controls if access to sensitive apps is needed. If you want, I can start the accommodation workflow for you.

Hiro: Thank you, appreciate that. What's the process to request the educational track? Is there a form or an email to send?

Lina: You can DM me the request and I'll route it. We have a standard confidentiality-first form on the intranet that flags accommodations to IT and SecOps without sharing specifics. Link (internal): https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/accommodations

Avery: For enrollment delay, we'll still provision SSO so you can access Slack and Docs. Sensitive tool access (secrets, payroll) will be restricted until device compliance is confirmed. If you need those immediately we can issue a temporary corp loaner.

secops-bot: Reminder: Security Foundations training due in 7 days. Phishing simulation scheduled: 2026-04-20 09:00 PT (participants may opt into education-only flow if accommodation recorded).

Hiro: Good to know. One technical q for later: when enrolling macOS, does Company Portal require approving a profile in System Settings > Profiles? I want to be ready but avoid doing anything that might disrupt personal settings.

Avery: Yes, Company Portal will prompt to install a management profile. It won't change your Apple ID or remove personal apps. If anything prompts for factory reset or Activation Lock, stop and DM us immediately. We can do a quick 10-min screen share to walk through and verify.

Lina: I'll DM you the private form link now, Hiro. Ping back once submitted and we'll flag the phishsim track + enrollment extension. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Hiro: Thanks so much, everyone. Really appreciate the quick help and flexibility.
